scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron desktop-build/app
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:runtime && npm run desktop:build && playwright test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src server shared desktop tests *.ts *.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src server shared desktop tests *.ts *.json
